input.quote: 2.2 Vendor will be Customer's sole and exclusive provider of hosted analytics services throughout the term.
input.rationale: Section 2.2 imposes full-term exclusive dealing on Customer (Vendor as sole and exclusive provider of hosted analytics services) with no category limit, time limit, or performance-based exit — the playbook walk-away position. It also conflicts with Section 2.1 (no minimum quantity or purchase commitment) and Section 12.3 (Customer has made no exclusivity commitment and may engage any supplier). The other "exclusive" references (13.1 non-exclusive licence, 19.4/21.4/30.2 exclusive remedy, 28.2 exclusive jurisdiction) are unrelated. Preferred remedy is deletion; fallback (defined category, 12 months, automatic termination on SLA/delivery failure) offered in the comment.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have deleted Section 2.2 because we cannot accept a sole-source or exclusivity commitment; it also contradicts Sections 2.1 and 12.3, which confirm no purchase commitment or exclusivity. If some exclusivity is important to you, we could consider a narrow version limited to a defined product category for 12 months that ends automatically if service levels or delivery dates are missed.
proposal.summary: Delete Section 2.2 sole and exclusive provider obligation on Customer.
